nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Retinol Serum

avis.texte: I have very sensitive, clog-prone skin, and First Aid Beauty is one of the only brands that hasn't caused breakouts for me. Unfortunately, this retinol did not work well with my skin. I would not recommend it for sensitive skin or enlarged/open pores. After using it, I started breaking out and couldn't figure out why. When I shined a flashlight on my skin after application, I noticed the product has a noticeable shimmer effect. My skin became congested shortly after using it, so I stopped. If you have very sensitive or pore-clogging-prone skin, I would use caution with this product.

avis.titre: Helpful for improving skin and supporting your routine, but
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like that this retinol serum helps improve skin texture and makes the skin look smoother and more even. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. My skin feels more cared for and looks more refreshed after using it. For best results, I apply it in the evening a few times a week. After that, I always follow with a night cream — it helps lock in moisture and makes the retinol feel gentler on the skin, preventing dryness. About four pumps are enough for my whole face and neck. I've been using it for about a month and still haven't finished the bottle, which is nice. I also think it's important to understand that this isn't a miracle product for deep wrinkles. It works more as a supportive skincare step to improve skin texture and overall appearance rather than a complete solution for deeper lines.

avis.titre: Gentle for Roseca-with smooth results and minimal purging
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Finding a retinol that works with permanent rosacea is a journey, but I'm impressed with this Fab retinol serum. I followed a specific routine using a cream cleanser, mild hydrating toner, the retinol serum ,hydrating essence, eye cream, and a heavier moisturizer thinned out with essence. In the serum photo the texture is creamy, lightweight, and non-greasy. (After skin care P1 )shows my skin right after the final step; it felt flushed and hot for a small amount of time with some mild itchiness. In (After Skincare P2) about 5 minutes later ,the reaction settled as it was absorbed. The next day photo shows the results: my skin is incredibly smooth, though I do have some mild dryness I also had some very mild purging with a few tiny, barely noticeable blemishes on the cheek that weren't painful or inflamed. I only use this at night and always follow up with a sensitive sunscreen during the day to protect the progress it's effective yet general enough for those who usually have to be careful with retinol's and my skin feels incredibly soft and not irritated.

avis.texte: I had the opportunity to try the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Retinol Serum. I used it consistently for about 2 weeks and I really loved it.
